title: Create: Oxidizing
description: Allows oxidizing copper by washing it.
body:
**Small datapack for the [Create mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) that allows making exposed, weathered & oxidized variants of all copper blocks by washing them**

---

**Does not work in 1.21.1**

**Has only been tested in Minecraft 1.20.1 with Create 0.5.1.j & 6.0.0 on Forge**

---
